title: Faqir rules definition
description: A form's contract: what each value must look like (fields) and everything that depends on the other values (rules). The same document is enforced in the page by the faqir-rules plugin and re-checked on the server by @faqir-ui/rules, so one definition means one thing. Hand this schema to a model as the structured-output schema; `faqir rules lint` then reports what a schema cannot say — a var naming no field, a compute cycle, an untranslated message, a condition that folds to a constant.

version.description: The definition format. "1" is the only value.

required.description: Field paths that must be present — the alternative to `required: true` on the field.

messages.description: { locale: { key: sentence } }. A key is "<rule>" or "<path>.<rule>"; a cross-field rule is addressed by its id. Placeholders in braces are filled from the finding's params.

defaultLocale.description: The locale a message falls back to. Defaults to "en".

rules.description: The verbs. Each rule carries a unique id and exactly one of them.

logic.description: A JSONLogic expression: a literal, an array of expressions, or a one-key { "<op>": <args> } object. Implemented operators: var, missing, missing_some, if, and, or, !, !!, ==, ===, !=, !==, <, <=, >, >=, +, -, *, /, %, min, max, cat, substr, in, some, all, none, date, regex. Anything else is refused when the definition is compiled.

field.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 subset, plus `required: true` as sugar for listing the path in the definition's `required`. The keyword set is closed per type: an unrecognised keyword is an error, never a constraint that silently does nothing.

format.description: A built-in name (email, uri, date, time, date-time, phone, iban, uuid, postal-code) or one added with registerFormat.

required.description: true — the object itself is required; an array — these properties are.

rule.description: Exactly one verb per rule. A rule with none, or with two, matches no branch here — which is what `faqir rules lint` reports as rule-verb.

ruleId.description: Unique in the definition. It is the `rule` a finding reports and the key a message is addressed to.

showRule.description: The field is on screen only while `when` holds. A hidden field is never required and its findings are dropped.

show.description: The field path this rule governs.

requireRule.description: The field must be filled in while `when` holds.

require.description: The field path this rule demands. It must be a key of `fields`.

validateRule.description: A cross-field check: a finding on `path` when the logic is falsy.

validate.description: A JSONLogic expression — anything but the string "remote", which is the other branch.

path.description: The field the finding is reported on.

message.description: This rule's sentence; a `messages` entry still wins over it.

remoteRule.description: A check only the network can answer. Sync `validate` leaves its id in `pending`; `validateAsync` resolves it.

remote.description: A url or a name; the resolver decides what it means.

computeRule.description: A derived value, written into the data the rest of the pass reads. Computes run first, in dependency order.

compute.description: The path the value is written to.

jumpRule.description: A wizard's next page: the first rule whose `when` holds wins for a given `from`. No `when` means unconditional.
